issue.title: 32.5G of orphaned per-workspace Rust target/ directories survive the shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR redirect

task_type_fields.impact:
## Impact

32.5G of unreclaimable-by-cargo disk on `/`. Not urgent — `/` sits at 54% used with 400G
available after epic bob-cli-15, well inside that epic's 75% target — and the new
`bryan/**/target/` backup exclude means these no longer cost anything on `/mnt/hercules`.
Pure local-disk waste that grows by one more copy per new workspace.

Proposed by bob-cli-15.4 as a `PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP:` note; filed by the bob-cli-15 land agent.
task_type_fields.repro:
## Repro

```bash
for d in $(find ~/.local/state/sase/workspaces -maxdepth 8 -type d -name target -prune); do /usr/bin/du -sh "$d"; done
/usr/bin/du -sh ~/projects/github/bobs-org/bob-cli/target
```

Measured 2026-08-26 10:15 EDT — 32.5G total:

| Path                                              | Size |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ---- |
| `workspaces/bobs-org/bob-cli/bob-cli_10/target`   | 12G  |
| `workspaces/bobs-org/bob-cli/bob-cli_11/target`   | 5.7G |
| `projects/github/bobs-org/bob-cli/target`         | 4.4G |
| `workspaces/bobs-org/bob-cli/bob-cli_12/target`   | 3.2G |
| `workspaces/bobs-org/bob-cli/bob-cli_13/target`   | 2.1G |
| `workspaces/bbugyi200/actstat/actstat_10/target`  | 1.6G |
| `workspaces/sase-org/sase/sase_{19,20,23,26,27}/sase/repos/linked/sase-core/target` | 755M each |

These are leftovers that predate the `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` redirect. `~/.cargo/config.toml`
now sets `build.target-dir = "/mnt/poseidon/cargo-target"`, no repo-local
`.cargo/config.toml` or `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` override exists in these checkouts, and no
file under `bob-cli_11/target` has been written since the redirect — so cargo will never
touch them again. They are dead weight, not live build state.

Epic bob-cli-15.4 deliberately left them alone: at the time every listed workspace was
claimed by a live agent, and deleting a running agent's tree is not safe. Repeat the same
`/sase_gate`-approved `rm` used there once the workspaces are unclaimed (`sase_19/20/23/26/27`
and `bob-cli_10-13` were all live on 2026-08-26; re-check occupancy before deleting).
